newsitem.title: CANADA: Bre-X falls on investor nervousness.
newsitem.headline: Bre-X falls on investor nervousness.

text.p: Bre-X Minerals Ltd stock fell in heavy trading on Tuesday as investors let their nerves get the best of them, analysts said.

Bre-X fell 2.40 to 20.15 on almost three million shares, topping actives in morning trading on the Toronto Stock Exchange. "There are a lot of retail investors that are very nervous," said gold analyst Catherine Gignac of Deacon Capital. Investors have been waiting for Bre-X to resolve an ownership dispute over its huge Busang discovery in Indonesia.
In late morning, Bre-X and Barrick Gold Corp were halted for news pending.
Rumors that Barrick was ready to make an offer for 75 percent of Busang have circulated in the market for days.
Recent speculation suggested that Indonesia's government pressured Barrick and Bre-X to come to an agreement in meetings with the two companies last week.

Bre-X has been searching for a major partner to act as operator and part owner of Busang, but the search has been clouded by the ownership disputes and the lack of contracts of work from the Indonesian government.
Barrick was up 0.55 to 37.10 in Toronto and by 5/8 to 27-3/4 in New York before the halt.
